conventions.sample: Post-step state on copied MjData, refreshed with mj_forward; live MjData is unchanged.
conventions.time_s: Seconds since reset returned; initial MuJoCo time is retained separately.
conventions.control_time_s: Start of the integration interval; desired positions/forces and command held over this interval.
conventions.contact_force_w: Instantaneous simulated constraint reaction at sample state under held control, ON the foot, world XYZ, N; not an integrated impulse or hardware sensor.
conventions.contact_measured: At least one active constraint (efc_address >= 0) between exact foot geom and a world-body geom. Intended for static flat terrain.
conventions.feet_pos_w: Foot geometry center in world XYZ metres; not ground contact point.
conventions.feet_desired_w: wb.last_des_foot_pos: swing trajectory sample or stance MPC foothold. Stance targets follow recent measured positions, not fixed world anchors.
conventions.feet_foothold_ref_w: Foothold planner touchdown reference, separate from instantaneous desired foot position.
conventions.contact_planned: wb.current_contact used for current torque; distinct from physical contact.
conventions.gait_phase: Raw PGG phase, dimensionless. FULL_STANCE resets phase to constant offsets; it is not elapsed standing phase.
conventions.phase: settling or standing; phase_time_s measures elapsed seconds within that phase.
conventions.base_quat_wxyz: Unit quaternion, scalar first; base_rpy_rad is extrinsic XYZ roll/pitch/yaw in radians.
conventions.base_ang_vel_b: Angular velocity in base frame, rad/s; linear velocities and all positions are world frame.
conventions.com_pos_w: Physical model CoM from body-mass-weighted xipos, independent of the controller's CoM estimate.
conventions.mpc_status: Held latest acados NLP status; count solves only where mpc_update is true. Status 2 is expected with default one-iteration SQP.
conventions.qp_status: Maximum absolute underlying QP status from latest solve (0 means success).
conventions.solver_time_s: Latest acados solve time; wall_time_s is recorder elapsed wall time, including rendering and logging.
conventions.actuator_torque: Applied torque after clipping, model actuator order, Nm; torque_saturated reports pre-clip limit violations.
